name: Calcumeter – Calc & Rates
subtitle: Calculator, currency, units
shortDescription: Calculator with currency and unit converter, graphing and programmer mode.
promotionalText: One calculator for everything: basic and scientific functions, 160 currencies with daily rates and an exchange-rate widget.
description:
Calcumeter is a modern full-screen calculator – clean, fast and with everything you need for everyday life, school and work.

CALCULATOR
• Basic arithmetic with live result and history
• Scientific functions: trigonometry (degrees/radians), logarithms, powers, roots, factorial, nCr/nPr
• Rotate to landscape and the scientific keys appear automatically
• Memory (M+, M−, MR), shop-style percentages (200 + 10% = 220)

CURRENCY
• About 160 currencies with daily rates, works offline too
• Your own favourites, search by name or code
• Exchange-rate widget for your home screen

UNITS
• Length, area, volume, weight, temperature, speed, time, data, energy, pressure

GRAPH
• Plot up to three functions, pan, zoom and read off values

PROGRAMMER
• HEX, DEC, OCT, BIN at once, 8 to 64 bit, AND/OR/XOR/NOT and bit view

COMFORT
• Light and dark mode, 15 languages
• Quick-start widget and app shortcuts
• Share results
• Swipe to delete the last input

The calculator itself is ad-free. The other sections show a small banner – watch a short video to go ad-free for 24 hours, or remove ads for good with a one-time purchase.
